신서고 부교재 · 수식어는 괄호로 묶어라 · 본문과 해석 WORKBOOK
STEP 01
1
본문과 해석
본문 + 해석 + 핵심 어휘 정리
원문 PASSAGE
1In 2011, Joao Pereira de Souza, an old man living in an island village near Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, found a penguin struggling on the beach. 2The helpless, starving creature covered in oil was adopted by Mr. de Souza and named Dindim. 3Mr. de Souza nursed him back to health and released him, thinking they would never meet again. 4Amazingly, though, Dindim returned! 5It is believed that he traveled around 5,000 miles between Mr. de Souza's house and the coasts of Argentina and Chile. 6What is more, he makes this journey every year. 7After spending about eight months with Mr. de Souza, he goes on his annual migration for his breeding routine, only to return once again.
전체 해석
12011년에, 브라질 리우데자네이루 근처의 한 섬 마을에 살던 노인 Joao Pereira de Souza는 해변에서 힘겨워하고 있는 펭귄 한 마리를 발견했다. 2기름을 뒤집어쓴 채 굶주리고 있던 그 무력한 생명체는 de Souza 씨에게 거두어져 Dindim이라는 이름을 얻었다. 3de Souza 씨는 그를 간호해 건강을 되찾게 한 뒤, 다시는 만나지 못할 것이라고 생각하며 그를 놓아주었다. 4그런데 놀랍게도, Dindim이 돌아왔다! 5그는 de Souza 씨의 집과 아르헨티나 및 칠레의 해안 사이를 약 5,000마일이나 이동한 것으로 여겨진다. 6게다가, 그는 이 여정을 해마다 한다. 7de Souza 씨와 여덟 달쯤을 보낸 뒤, 그는 번식이라는 정해진 일과를 위해 해마다 하는 이주를 떠나지만, 결국 또다시 돌아온다.
필수 단어
1. island[명]섬
2. village[명]마을, 촌락
3. struggle[동]힘겨워하다, 발버둥 치다
4. helpless[형]무력한, 속수무책인
5. starving[형]굶주린, 굶어 죽어 가는
6. creature[명]생명체, 동물
7. covered in[구]~로 뒤덮인
8. adopt[동]입양하다, 거두어 기르다
9. name[동]이름을 붙이다, 명명하다
10. nurse ... back to health[구]간호해 건강을 되찾게 하다
11. release[동]놓아주다, 방면하다
12. amazingly[부]놀랍게도
13. though[부]그런데, 하지만 (문중·문미 부사)
14. return[동]돌아오다, 되돌아가다
15. it is believed that[구]~라고 여겨진다
16. travel[동]이동하다, 여행하다
17. coast[명]해안, 연안
18. what is more[구]게다가, 더욱이
19. journey[명]여정, 여행
20. spend[동](시간을) 보내다, 쓰다
동의어 ≈
1.island = isle
2.village = hamlet, settlement
3.struggle = strain, flounder
4.helpless = powerless, defenseless
5.starving = famished, ravenous
반의어 ↔
1.island ↔ mainland
2.village ↔ city, metropolis
3.struggle ↔ thrive, cope easily
4.helpless ↔ capable, self-reliant
5.starving ↔ well-fed, full
영영풀이
1.village: a small group of houses in the countryside
2.helpless: not able to protect or take care of oneself
3.creature: a living animal of any kind
4.coasts: the land beside the sea
5.migration: the seasonal movement of animals from one place to another
필수 표현
1.covered in: ~로 뒤덮인
2.nursed him back to health: 간호해 건강을 되찾게 하다
3.It is believed that: ~라고 여겨진다
4.What is more: 게다가, 더욱이
5.only to return: (결국) ~하고 말다

The helpless, starving creature covered in oil was adopted by Mr. de Souza and named Dindim.
3
Mr. de Souza nursed him back to health and released him, thinking they would never meet again.
4
Amazingly, though, Dindim returned!
5
It is believed that he traveled around 5,000 miles between Mr. de Souza's house and the coasts of Argentina and Chile.
6
What is more, he makes this journey every year.
7
After spending about eight months with Mr. de Souza, he goes on his annual migration for his breeding routine, only to return once again.
